items.source:
Contract for a runnable query specification which still can be bound to a specific
database and an impersonated user.
items.translation: 用于可执行查询规范的合同，该规范仍可绑定到特定数据库和模拟用户。

items.source: Pins the previously defined query to an impersonated user.
items.translation: 将先前定义的查询绑定到模拟用户。

items.source: Pins the previously defined query to a specific database.
items.translation: 将先前定义的查询绑定到特定数据库。

items.source:
Pins the previously defined query to a specific database. A value of
null chooses the default database. The empty string "" is
not permitted.
items.translation: 将先前定义的查询绑定到特定数据库。值为 null 时选择默认数据库。不允许使用空字符串 ""。

items.source:
Pins the previously defined query to an impersonated user. A value of
null chooses the user owning the physical connection. The empty
string "" is not permitted.
items.translation: 将先前定义的查询绑定到模拟用户。值为 null 时选择拥有物理连接的用户。空字符串 "" 不被允许。

items.source: targetDatabase - selected database to use. A null value indicates the default database.
items.translation: targetDatabase - 选定的目标数据库。空值表示使用默认数据库。

items.source: asUser - the name of the user to impersonate. A null value indicates the connected user.
items.translation: asUser - 要模拟的用户名称。null 值表示当前连接的用户。
